column1: # databasechangelog of a database built by Liquibase 3.6.3: one row per changeset,
# id <TAB> author <TAB> filename <TAB> md5sum, in execution order.
# Source: the full changelog (classpath:migration/master.xml, no contexts, so the
# demo seeds are included) applied by Liquibase 3.6.3's SpringLiquibase to an
# empty postgres:14-alpine, on 2026-10-02, at the commit before the Liquibase 4
# upgrade. Every production and dev database was built this way, so these are the
# checksums they held before their first start on Liquibase 4.
# Frozen: never regenerate this file with a newer Liquibase. New changesets do not
# belong here; Liquibase 4 writes their checksums itself.
